title: HAS WORLD WAR 3 ALREADY STARTED? Does the Bible Say What's Ahead?
summary: A Bible teacher reads 2024 news on Iran, Israel and Russia as fulfilment of prophecy, says a global war has begun and the Ezekiel 38 invasion of Israel is near, and promotes his free prophecy course.

assertions.quote: So this we're seeing I would say is already World War II. This is a global war.
God has clearly told us a war is coming.
Ezekiel 38 and39 event where Israel is really attacked directly by Iran and Russia

verdicts.note: Russia keeps working ties with Israel and has shown no intent to attack it; Iran's strikes have been missile and proxy attacks, not an invasion with Russia.

assertions.quote: according to the Israeli government and the US government 99% of the 300 were intercepted

verdicts.note: Israel, the US and allies reported intercepting nearly all of the roughly 300 drones and missiles, with minor damage at one air base.

assertions.quote: they're soon going to deploy their weapons uh within they say 21 days
historians are saying it's never been this dangerous in the world since about 1939

verdicts.note: Many experts and the Doomsday Clock rate current risk as very high, but most historians would rank the 1962 Cuban missile crisis as more dangerous.
The Clock at its closest-ever setting supports a judgment of exceptional danger, but it is a composite of several global risks set by an expert board, not a measure of danger since 1939.
CFR says the world has become more violent, with armed conflicts at their highest since WWII; a count of conflicts does not establish the most dangerous moment since 1939.
UCDP: 8 interstate conflicts in 2025 is the highest since WWII by a fair margin, but they are concentrated in a few countries, and total battle deaths stay below Cold War-era peaks.
PRIO: 2021-2025 was the most violent stretch since the end of the Cold War, a narrower comparison than since 1939.

The WEF report says, citing the Global Peace Index, that key conflict-risk indicators are at their worst levels since the Second World War. That supports the claim for armed-conflict measures since 1945, but not for danger overall or for a comparison that reaches back to 1939.

assertions.quote: it will wipe out the power grid within the range of that blast

verdicts.note: A high-altitude burst would cause an electromagnetic pulse that could damage grid equipment over a wide area, but how much would fail and for how long is disputed.

assertions.quote: Macron just announced this week that he's deploying France's nuclear warheads to to form a nuclear shield against Russia.

verdicts.note: In 2024 Macron only offered to discuss a European dimension of French deterrence; he did not move submarine warheads across Europe.

SIPRI's 2026 account has European states wanting nuclear-sharing arrangements with France and Macron saying in March 2026 that France was in dialogue with Germany and the UK; no French warheads deployed across Europe, let alone in 2024.

assertions.quote: God says there's going to be a global hatred for Israel that's going to grip the world.

verdicts.note: A theological interpretation of current events.
